description: Import and Export Control Department -  Imports and Exports (Control ) Act, No. 1 of 1969 - Promulgate Regulations
reasoning: This gazette content promulgates new regulations under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969, specifically creating the "Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 04 of 2021." It modifies import controls, adds/removes items from schedules, and establishes licensing requirements and fees for palm oil imports. This constitutes regulatory framework creation and modification, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories.
